correctness.rationale: For each edge xy, girth five implies disjoint (d−1)-element neighbor sides X,Y with all cross-distances exactly two. The edge functional of αI+βA depends only on u=f(x)−f(y), v=mean_X f−f(y), w=mean_Y f−f(y); Lipschitz constraints reduce exactly to six inequalities and the McShane extension makes every feasible triple extendible. For β>=0, optimizing v−w yields min{2,u+2}, and the maximum occurs at u=−1,0,1, giving three affine branches. Sign symmetry extends to β<0 and proves the max of three absolute values for every real α,β. Moore adjacency identity A²=(d−1)I−A+J gives the two-eigenvalue spectral interpolation for any real filter. Exact rational checks of all known example graphs and full LP independent samples agree with these universal analytic steps; finite checks are not used to infer infinity.

originality.rationale: The proposed exact six-facet operator norm covers every real signed adjacency filter on diameter-two girth-five Moore graphs. The closest primary theorem (Bonini et al., arXiv:1907.06733, Thm. 1.4 and Sec. 2) computes infinitesimal curvature and the high-idleness *positive* Markov subfamily. Coupled to the known two-eigenvalue Moore adjacency algebra, that result can derive the heat-flow specialization and is explicitly credited; it does not characterize the remaining signed filter sectors or their three-phase sharp norm. The full signed norm was not identified under operator-norm, Lipschitz, transportation or spectral-filter aliases in the checked public research and available historical claim records. No novelty is attributed to the curvature or the positive-branch corollary.

value.rationale: The object is the natural real graph-distance Lipschitz operator norm of the complete two-dimensional nonconstant adjacency spectral calculus, relevant to boundedness of signed graph filters. The claim gives its full sharp polyhedral geometry, including two sectors unavailable to positive Markov transport/curvature methods; it supplies optimal potentials and a uniform formula independent of graph automorphism assumptions. This is a complete exact classification across all real spectral multipliers on three canonical graph metrics (and conditionally any degree-57 example), not an arbitrary numeric slice. The exact heat amplification peak 49/45 is a motivated consequence rather than the sole scientific contribution. Value would diminish if a preexisting association-scheme multiplier theorem proves the same three facets.
